photo.title: Lavender Soy Candle in Amber Glass
photo.tagline: Hand-poured soy wax with a wooden wick, in a reusable amber jar
photo.description:
A calm, cosy candle for slow evenings. It's hand-poured with soy wax and topped with a wooden wick, in an amber glass jar you can reuse once the candle is done.

Light it while you read, take a bath or wind down after work. Trim the wick before each burn for a clean, steady flame.

faq.a: Orders ship within 2 to 3 business days. You'll get an email with tracking once it's on the way.

faq.q: How do I get the best burn?
faq.a: Let the top melt all the way to the edge the first time you light it, and trim the wick before each burn.
Unused candles can be returned within 30 days. Message us and we'll help.

photo.alt_text: Soy candle in an amber glass jar with a wooden wick on a kitchen counter next to dried lavender
